test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

The receptionist asked if Diya / will take a seat and / wait for the boss to call her in.

options.text: wait for the boss to call her in

solution: Here, the erroneous part is "will take a seat and."
